Subject: Casework archive enquiry - Tŷ Mawr (Great House Farm), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, demolished 1988



Dear Victorian Society,



I am researching the history of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan (approx. ST 168 733), the house beside St Dochdwy's Church. The house was demolished in early December 1988. The South Wales Echo of 3 December 1988 ("History fight to save farm") reported that Cadw was considering spot-listing the farmhouse and that an inspector was due to visit that weekend.



As the Society is a national amenity society consulted on proposals to demolish listed buildings in Wales, please could you check its casework records, archive and indexes for any file, notification, correspondence or photographs about:



1. Tŷ Mawr / Great House Farm, Llandough-juxta-Penarth (also "Llandough near Penarth"); and 2. its threatened demolition or possible listing in 1988, or any later consultation about the site up to 1995.



If the Society's older casework files are now held elsewhere, I would be grateful to know where. If a file exists, please could you give its reference, date range, a short description of the contents and how it may be consulted.



I would welcome a short acknowledgement.



Kind regards,



Requester 

Royal Signals Cyber/ Electronic Warfare Professional bucklerfamily.estate
